id-20260924-news-1.title: BI Rate Remains at 5.75 Percent for the Third Consecutive Time, BI Prioritizes Rupiah Stability Amid Middle East Conflict Escalation

segments.src: Bank Indonesia (BI) kembali menahan suku bunga acuan atau BI Rate di level **5,75 persen**.
segments.tr: Bank Indonesia (BI) once again holds the benchmark interest rate or BI Rate at the level of **5.75 percent**.

segments.src: Keputusan ini diambil dalam Rapat Dewan Gubernur (RDG) BI pada 22–23 September 2026 dan menjadi yang ketiga kalinya secara beruntun BI mempertahankan level tersebut.
segments.tr: This decision was made during the BI Board of Governors Meeting (RDG) on September 22–23, 2026, and this is the third consecutive time BI has maintained this level.

segments.src: Menurut Gubernur BI, langkah ini selaras dengan upaya menjaga stabilitas nilai tukar rupiah di tengah tekanan eksternal, eskalasi perang di Timur Tengah, dan pengetatan moneter global.
segments.tr: According to the BI Governor, this step aligns with efforts to maintain the stability of the rupiah exchange rate amid external pressures, escalation of conflict in the Middle East, and global monetary tightening.

segments.src: ## Ringkasan Keputusan RDG September 2026
segments.tr: ## Summary of the September 2026 RDG Decision

segments.src: | Instrumen | Level |
segments.tr: | Instrument | Level |

segments.src: | BI Rate | 5,75 persen |
segments.tr: | BI Rate | 5.75 percent |

segments.src: | Suku bunga Deposit Facility | 4,75 persen |
segments.tr: | Deposit Facility Interest Rate | 4.75 percent |

segments.src: | Suku bunga Lending Facility | 6,50 persen |
segments.tr: | Lending Facility Interest Rate | 6.50 percent |

segments.src: Dengan level tersebut, Deposit Facility berada 100 basis poin (1 persen) di bawah BI Rate, sedangkan Lending Facility berada 75 basis poin (0,75 persen) di atasnya.
segments.tr: At these levels, the Deposit Facility is 100 basis points (1 percent) below the BI Rate, while the Lending Facility is 75 basis points (0.75 percent) above it.

segments.src: Ketiganya membentuk koridor suku bunga kebijakan moneter BI.
segments.tr: These three form the corridor of BI's monetary policy interest rates.

segments.src: ## Apa Itu BI Rate, Deposit Facility, dan Lending Facility?
segments.tr: ## What Are BI Rate, Deposit Facility, and Lending Facility?

segments.src: Bagi pembaca yang belum familier dengan istilah perbankan sentral, berikut penjelasan singkatnya:
segments.tr: For readers not yet familiar with central banking terminology, here is a brief explanation:

segments.src: - **BI Rate** adalah suku bunga kebijakan yang mencerminkan sikap kebijakan moneter BI. Level ini menjadi rujukan bagi pergerakan suku bunga di pasar uang dan perbankan.
segments.tr: - **BI Rate** is the policy interest rate that reflects BI's monetary policy stance. This level serves as a reference for interest rate movements in the money and banking markets.

segments.src: - **Deposit Facility** adalah suku bunga yang diberikan BI kepada bank yang menempatkan kelebihan dananya di bank sentral.
segments.tr: - **Deposit Facility** is the interest rate offered by BI to banks that place excess funds at the central bank.

segments.src: - **Lending Facility** adalah suku bunga yang dikenakan BI ketika bank meminjam dana dari bank sentral untuk memenuhi kebutuhan likuiditas jangka pendek.
segments.tr: - **Lending Facility** is the interest rate charged by BI when banks borrow funds from the central bank to meet short-term liquidity needs.

segments.src: ## Mengapa Stabilitas Rupiah Jadi Prioritas?
segments.tr: ## Why Is Rupiah Stability a Priority?

segments.src: Nilai tukar merupakan salah satu indikator yang paling cepat merespons perubahan sentimen global.
segments.tr: Exchange rate is one of the indicators that responds most quickly to changes in global sentiment.

segments.src: Dalam pernyataannya, Gubernur BI menyebut keputusan menahan BI Rate sejalan dengan upaya menstabilkan rupiah.
segments.tr: In his statement, the BI Governor stated that the decision to hold the BI Rate aligns with efforts to stabilize the rupiah.

segments.src: Ada tiga faktor eksternal yang disorot:
segments.tr: There are three external factors highlighted:

segments.src: 1. **Tekanan eksternal secara umum.** Perubahan arah arus modal global dapat memengaruhi permintaan terhadap aset di negara berkembang, termasuk Indonesia.
segments.tr: 1. **General external pressures.** Changes in the direction of global capital flows can affect demand for assets in developing countries, including Indonesia.

segments.src: 2. **Eskalasi perang di Timur Tengah.** Meningkatnya ketegangan di kawasan tersebut menambah ketidakpastian global. Situasi seperti ini biasanya membuat investor lebih berhati-hati dan cenderung memilih aset yang dianggap aman, sehingga mata uang negara berkembang dapat berada di bawah tekanan.
segments.tr: 2. **Escalation of conflict in the Middle East.** Increased tensions in the region add to global uncertainty. This type of situation typically makes investors more cautious and tend to choose assets considered safe, so developing country currencies can come under pressure.

segments.src: 3. **Pengetatan moneter global.** Ketika bank sentral di negara-negara besar mempertahankan suku bunga tinggi, selisih imbal hasil antara aset di dalam negeri dan di luar negeri bisa menyempit, sehingga memengaruhi minat investor terhadap aset berdenominasi rupiah.
segments.tr: 3. **Global monetary tightening.** When central banks in major countries maintain high interest rates, the yield differential between domestic and foreign assets can narrow, affecting investor interest in rupiah-denominated assets.

segments.src: Dalam kondisi demikian, mempertahankan BI Rate di 5,75 persen dapat dipahami sebagai pilihan yang menjaga daya tarik aset domestik sekaligus menghindari perubahan kebijakan yang mendadak di tengah ketidakpastian.
segments.tr: Under such conditions, maintaining the BI Rate at 5.75 percent can be understood as a choice that preserves the attractiveness of domestic assets while avoiding sudden policy changes amid uncertainty.

segments.src: ## Apa Artinya bagi Masyarakat dan Pelaku Usaha?
segments.tr: ## What Does This Mean for the Public and Business Operators?

segments.src: Keputusan menahan suku bunga acuan tidak serta-merta mengubah biaya dan imbal hasil yang dirasakan masyarakat, tetapi memberi sinyal tentang arah kebijakan.
segments.tr: The decision to hold the benchmark interest rate does not directly change the costs and returns experienced by the public, but it signals the direction of policy.

segments.src: Beberapa hal yang dapat dicermati:
segments.tr: Some things that can be observed:

segments.src: - **Kredit dan cicilan.** Karena BI Rate tidak berubah, tidak ada dorongan langsung dari kebijakan moneter untuk menaikkan atau menurunkan suku bunga kredit. Namun, suku bunga kredit di masing-masing bank tetap dipengaruhi faktor lain, seperti biaya dana, profil risiko debitur, dan strategi bisnis bank.
segments.tr: - **Credit and installments.** Since the BI Rate has not changed, there is no direct impetus from monetary policy to raise or lower credit interest rates. However, credit interest rates at each bank are still affected by other factors, such as funding costs, debtor risk profile, and the bank's business strategy.

segments.src: - **Tabungan dan deposito.** Suku bunga simpanan juga ditentukan oleh masing-masing bank sehingga dapat berbeda antarbank dan antarproduk. Nasabah disarankan membandingkan penawaran sebelum menempatkan dana.
segments.tr: - **Savings and deposits.** Savings interest rates are also determined by each bank, so they can vary between banks and products. Customers are advised to compare offers before placing funds.

segments.src: - **Pelaku usaha.** Stabilitas nilai tukar penting bagi pelaku usaha yang bergantung pada bahan baku impor atau memiliki kewajiban dalam valuta asing, karena memudahkan perencanaan biaya dan harga.
segments.tr: - **Business operators.** Exchange rate stability is important for business operators who depend on imported raw materials or have obligations in foreign currency, as it facilitates cost and price planning.

segments.src: ## Hal yang Perlu Dicermati ke Depan
segments.tr: ## Things to Watch Going Forward

segments.src: Arah kebijakan BI pada bulan-bulan mendatang akan bergantung pada perkembangan sejumlah faktor, di antaranya dinamika geopolitik di Timur Tengah, arah kebijakan moneter bank sentral utama dunia, serta pergerakan nilai tukar rupiah dan inflasi domestik.
segments.tr: The direction of BI's policy in the coming months will depend on developments in a number of factors, including geopolitical dynamics in the Middle East, the monetary policy direction of the world's major central banks, and movements in the rupiah exchange rate and domestic inflation.

segments.src: Pengamat dan pelaku pasar umumnya memantau data-data tersebut karena menjadi pertimbangan utama dalam setiap RDG.
segments.tr: Observers and market participants typically monitor these data because they are key considerations in every RDG.

segments.src: Perlu diingat bahwa BI biasanya menyampaikan keputusannya berdasarkan data terkini dan dapat menyesuaikan kebijakan bila kondisi berubah.
segments.tr: It should be remembered that BI typically announces its decisions based on current data and can adjust policy if conditions change.

segments.src: Karena itu, informasi resmi dari BI tetap menjadi rujukan utama.
segments.tr: Therefore, official information from BI remains the primary reference.

segments.src: ## Penutup
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Keputusan BI mempertahankan BI Rate di 5,75 persen untuk ketiga kalinya secara beruntun menunjukkan bahwa stabilitas rupiah menjadi perhatian utama di tengah ketidakpastian global.
segments.tr: BI's decision to maintain the BI Rate at 5.75 percent for the third consecutive time shows that rupiah stability is a primary concern amid global uncertainty.

segments.src: Bagi masyarakat, langkah ini sebaiknya dibaca sebagai bagian dari upaya menjaga stabilitas ekonomi, bukan sebagai patokan tunggal untuk mengambil keputusan keuangan pribadi.
segments.tr: For the public, this step should be read as part of efforts to maintain economic stability, not as the sole benchmark for making personal financial decisions.

segments.src: *Catatan: Artikel ini bersifat informatif dan bukan merupakan nasihat investasi atau keuangan.
segments.tr: *Note: This article is informational and not investment or financial advice.

segments.src: Untuk data dan pernyataan resmi, silakan merujuk pada publikasi Bank Indonesia.*
segments.tr: For data and official statements, please refer to Bank Indonesia publications.*

id-20260924-news-2.title: 276 Residents in Batang Suspected of Food Poisoning from MBG Menu, SPPG Bawang Distribution Suspended Temporarily until Lab Test Results Released

segments.src: Ratusan penerima manfaat program Makan Bergizi Gratis (MBG) di Kecamatan Bawang, Kabupaten Batang, Jawa Tengah, dilaporkan mengalami gangguan kesehatan setelah menyantap menu program tersebut pada Rabu (23/9).
segments.tr: Hundreds of beneficiaries of the Free Nutritious Meal (MBG) program in Bawang District, Batang Regency, Central Java, reportedly experienced health disturbances after consuming the program menu on Wednesday (23/9).

segments.src: Sebanyak 276 orang dari 11 satuan pendidikan diduga terdampak.
segments.tr: A total of 276 people from 11 educational units are suspected to be affected.

segments.src: Sebagai langkah awal, distribusi makanan dari Satuan Pelayanan Pemenuhan Gizi (SPPG) Bawang dihentikan sementara sambil menunggu hasil pemeriksaan laboratorium.
segments.tr: As an initial step, food distribution from the Nutrition Fulfillment Service Unit (SPPG) Bawang has been temporarily suspended while awaiting laboratory test results.

segments.src: ## Apa yang Diketahui Sejauh Ini
segments.tr: ## What Is Known So Far

segments.src: Berdasarkan informasi yang tersedia, para penerima manfaat yang mengalami keluhan berasal dari 11 satuan pendidikan di wilayah Kecamatan Bawang.
segments.tr: Based on available information, the beneficiaries who experienced complaints come from 11 educational units in the Bawang District area.

segments.src: Kejadian ini muncul setelah makanan dari SPPG setempat dibagikan pada Rabu (23/9).
segments.tr: This incident occurred after food from the local SPPG was distributed on Wednesday (23/9).

segments.src: Beberapa hal penting yang perlu dicatat:
segments.tr: Several important points to note:

segments.src: - **Jumlah terdampak:** 276 orang diduga mengalami gangguan kesehatan.
segments.tr: - **Number affected:** 276 people are suspected to have experienced health disturbances.

segments.src: - **Cakupan:** korban berasal dari 11 satuan pendidikan di Kecamatan Bawang.
segments.tr: - **Scope:** victims come from 11 educational units in Bawang District.

segments.src: - **Waktu kejadian:** Rabu (23/9).
segments.tr: - **Time of incident:** Wednesday (23/9).

segments.src: - **Status penyebab:** masih dugaan. Penyebab pasti belum dapat dipastikan sebelum hasil uji laboratorium keluar.
segments.tr: - **Status of cause:** still suspected. The exact cause cannot be confirmed until laboratory test results are released.

segments.src: Karena proses penanganan masih berjalan, angka dan kondisi para penerima manfaat dapat berubah seiring pembaruan data dari pihak berwenang.
segments.tr: Because the handling process is still ongoing, the numbers and conditions of the beneficiaries may change as data is updated by the authorities.

segments.src: Pembaca disarankan merujuk pada keterangan resmi pemerintah daerah, dinas kesehatan, dan Badan Gizi Nasional (BGN).
segments.tr: Readers are advised to refer to official statements from the regional government, health department, and National Nutrition Agency (BGN).

segments.src: ## Distribusi Dihentikan Sementara
segments.tr: ## Distribution Temporarily Suspended

segments.src: Setelah kejadian ini, operasional distribusi makanan dari SPPG Bawang dihentikan sementara.
segments.tr: Following this incident, food distribution operations from SPPG Bawang have been temporarily suspended.

segments.src: Penghentian ini bersifat pencegahan agar tidak ada penerima manfaat lain yang berisiko sampai penyebab kejadian dapat dipastikan.
segments.tr: This suspension is precautionary to prevent other beneficiaries from being at risk until the cause of the incident can be confirmed.

segments.src: Langkah tersebut lazim diambil dalam penanganan dugaan keracunan pangan, yaitu menahan distribusi lebih dahulu, mengamankan sampel, lalu menelusuri sumber masalah dari hulu ke hilir.
segments.tr: This step is commonly taken in handling suspected food poisoning cases, namely halting distribution first, securing samples, and then tracing the source of the problem from upstream to downstream.

segments.src: Distribusi baru dapat dipertimbangkan kembali setelah hasil pemeriksaan dan evaluasi selesai.
segments.tr: New distribution can be reconsidered after examination and evaluation results are completed.

segments.src: ## Sampel Makanan Diperiksa di Laboratorium
segments.tr: ## Food Samples Examined in Laboratory

segments.src: Sampel makanan yang dibagikan kepada penerima manfaat telah dikirim untuk diperiksa di laboratorium.
segments.tr: Food samples distributed to beneficiaries have been sent for laboratory examination.

segments.src: Pemeriksaan ini bertujuan mengetahui ada tidaknya kontaminasi, misalnya oleh bakteri, zat kimia, atau faktor lain yang memicu keluhan kesehatan.
segments.tr: This examination aims to determine whether there is contamination, such as from bacteria, chemicals, or other factors that trigger health complaints.

segments.src: Hasil uji laboratorium menjadi rujukan utama, sebab gejala seperti mual, sakit perut, atau diare dapat disebabkan oleh berbagai hal.
segments.tr: Laboratory test results are the primary reference, because symptoms such as nausea, abdominal pain, or diarrhea can be caused by various factors.

segments.src: Tanpa data laboratorium, kesimpulan mengenai penyebab belum bisa ditarik.
segments.tr: Without laboratory data, conclusions about the cause cannot be drawn.

segments.src: Oleh karena itu, masyarakat diimbau tidak berspekulasi dan tidak menyebarkan informasi yang belum terverifikasi.
segments.tr: Therefore, the public is urged not to speculate and not to spread unverified information.

segments.src: ## SOP Keamanan Pangan Ikut Dievaluasi
segments.tr: ## Food Safety SOP Also Under Evaluation

segments.src: Selain pemeriksaan sampel, standar operasional prosedur (SOP) keamanan pangan di SPPG turut dievaluasi.
segments.tr: In addition to sample examination, food safety standard operating procedures (SOP) at SPPG are also being evaluated.

segments.src: Evaluasi ini biasanya mencakup rantai pengolahan makanan secara menyeluruh, antara lain:
segments.tr: This evaluation typically covers the entire food processing chain, including:

segments.src: 1. **Pemilihan dan penyimpanan bahan baku**, termasuk kesegaran dan suhu penyimpanan.
segments.tr: 1. **Selection and storage of raw materials**, including freshness and storage temperature.

segments.src: 2. **Higienitas dapur dan petugas**, mulai dari kebersihan alat hingga praktik cuci tangan.
segments.tr: 2. **Kitchen and staff hygiene**, from equipment cleanliness to handwashing practices.

segments.src: 3. **Proses memasak**, terutama kematangan dan pengendalian waktu.
segments.tr: 3. **Cooking process**, especially doneness and time control.

segments.src: 4. **Jeda waktu antara memasak dan penyajian**, karena makanan yang terlalu lama dibiarkan pada suhu ruang lebih rentan tercemar.
segments.tr: 4. **Time interval between cooking and serving**, because food left at room temperature for too long is more susceptible to contamination.

segments.src: 5. **Pengemasan dan distribusi** ke sekolah-sekolah penerima.
segments.tr: 5. **Packaging and distribution** to recipient schools.

segments.src: Evaluasi semacam ini penting agar program yang menyasar peserta didik dan kelompok penerima lain berjalan dengan standar keamanan yang konsisten, bukan hanya mengejar target jumlah porsi.
segments.tr: Such evaluation is important so that programs targeting students and other recipient groups run with consistent safety standards, not just chasing portion quantity targets.

segments.src: ## Mengapa Kasus Ini Menjadi Perhatian
segments.tr: ## Why This Case Has Drawn Attention

segments.src: Program MBG dirancang untuk mendukung pemenuhan gizi anak sekolah dan kelompok penerima manfaat lain.
segments.tr: The MBG program is designed to support nutritional fulfillment for school children and other recipient groups.

segments.src: Skala programnya yang besar membuat keamanan pangan menjadi aspek yang tidak bisa ditawar.
segments.tr: The program's large scale makes food safety a non-negotiable aspect.

segments.src: Ketika ratusan orang terdampak sekaligus, wajar bila publik menuntut penjelasan yang transparan, penanganan medis yang cepat, dan perbaikan sistem yang nyata.
segments.tr: When hundreds of people are affected at once, it is natural for the public to demand transparent explanations, prompt medical treatment, and tangible system improvements.

segments.src: Di sisi lain, penting untuk menunggu hasil pemeriksaan resmi sebelum menyimpulkan penyebab atau menyalahkan pihak tertentu.
segments.tr: On the other hand, it is important to wait for official examination results before concluding about the cause or blaming a particular party.

segments.src: Penilaian yang tergesa-gesa dapat menyesatkan dan menghambat proses penanganan yang sebenarnya.
segments.tr: Hasty judgments can be misleading and hinder the actual handling process.

segments.src: ## Imbauan bagi Orang Tua dan Sekolah
segments.tr: ## Appeal to Parents and Schools

segments.src: Selama proses penanganan berlangsung, sejumlah langkah berikut dapat dilakukan:
segments.tr: During the handling process, the following steps can be taken:

segments.src: - **Pantau kondisi anak.** Jika muncul gejala seperti mual, muntah, diare, sakit perut, atau demam, segera bawa ke fasilitas kesehatan terdekat.
segments.tr: - **Monitor your child's condition.** If symptoms such as nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, or fever appear, take them to the nearest health facility immediately.

segments.src: - **Jaga hidrasi.** Pastikan anak cukup minum, terutama jika mengalami diare atau muntah, dan ikuti arahan tenaga kesehatan.
segments.tr: - **Maintain hydration.** Ensure your child drinks enough, especially if experiencing diarrhea or vomiting, and follow health worker instructions.

segments.src: - **Simpan informasi.** Catat waktu makan, menu yang dikonsumsi, dan waktu munculnya gejala. Data ini membantu petugas kesehatan.
segments.tr: - **Keep information.** Record the time of eating, menu consumed, and time of symptom onset. This data helps health workers.

segments.src: - **Jangan mengonsumsi sisa makanan yang dicurigai.** Serahkan kepada petugas bila diminta untuk keperluan pemeriksaan.
segments.tr: - **Do not consume suspected leftover food.** Hand it over to officials if requested for examination purposes.

segments.src: - **Ikuti informasi resmi.** Rujuk pada pengumuman dari sekolah, dinas kesehatan, pemerintah daerah, atau BGN.
segments.tr: - **Follow official information.** Refer to announcements from the school, health department, regional government, or BGN.

segments.src: ## Menunggu Hasil dan Langkah Berikutnya
segments.tr: ## Awaiting Results and Next Steps

segments.src: Perkembangan kasus ini bergantung pada hasil uji laboratorium dan evaluasi SOP di SPPG Bawang.
segments.tr: The development of this case depends on laboratory test results and SOP evaluation at SPPG Bawang.

segments.src: Jika ditemukan kelemahan dalam proses pengolahan atau distribusi, perbaikan perlu dilakukan sebelum layanan kembali berjalan.
segments.tr: If weaknesses are found in the processing or distribution process, improvements must be made before service resumes.

segments.src: Bagi masyarakat, kejadian ini menjadi pengingat bahwa pengawasan mutu dan keamanan pangan harus berjalan beriringan dengan perluasan program.
segments.tr: For the community, this incident is a reminder that quality control and food safety must go hand in hand with program expansion.

segments.src: *Artikel ini disusun berdasarkan informasi yang tersedia pada saat penulisan dan dapat diperbarui mengikuti keterangan resmi dari pihak berwenang.
segments.tr: *This article is compiled based on information available at the time of writing and may be updated following official statements from the authorities.

segments.src: Tulisan ini bukan pengganti saran medis.
segments.tr: This article is not a substitute for medical advice.

segments.src: Jika Anda atau anggota keluarga mengalami gejala, segera hubungi tenaga kesehatan.*
segments.tr: If you or a family member experience symptoms, contact a health worker immediately.*

id-20260924-intro-retail-6.title: [Retail #6] Retail Without Store: Indonesia's Longest Shelf is in Your Hands

segments.src: > Ritel nirtoko adalah penjualan eceran yang terjadi tanpa gerai fisik — dari penjualan langsung dan TV home shopping sampai marketplace dan live commerce di ponsel. Yang hilang bukan cuma bangunannya, tapi seluruh struktur biaya dan cara pembeli menemukan barang.
segments.tr: > Non-store retail is retail sales that occur without a physical store — from direct selling and TV home shopping to online marketplaces and live commerce on mobile. What disappears is not just the building, but the entire cost structure and the way customers find products.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: Di kuliah ritel ada satu mantra klasik: *location, location, location*.
segments.tr: In retail class there is one classic mantra: *location, location, location*.

segments.src: Nilai sebuah toko sangat ditentukan oleh berapa banyak orang yang lewat di depannya.
segments.tr: A store's value is highly determined by how many people pass in front of it.

segments.src: Sewa di pinggir jalan besar mahal justru karena Anda sedang membeli lalu lintas manusia.
segments.tr: Rent on a busy street is expensive precisely because you are buying human foot traffic.

segments.src: **Ritel nirtoko** (*non-store retailing*) adalah semua bentuk penjualan eceran ke konsumen akhir yang tidak mengandalkan gerai fisik.
segments.tr: **Non-store retail** (*non-store retailing*) is all forms of retail sales to end consumers that do not rely on a physical store.

segments.src: Secara umum ia dikelompokkan jadi empat keluarga:
segments.tr: Generally, it is grouped into four families:

segments.src: 1. **Penjualan langsung (*direct selling*)** — penjual bertemu pembeli di rumah, kantor, atau arisan. Contohnya model keagenan Tupperware, Oriflame, atau produk perawatan kulit yang dijual reseller lewat WhatsApp.
segments.tr: 1. **Direct selling** — the seller meets the buyer at home, office, or social gathering. Examples include the Tupperware agency model, Oriflame, or skincare products sold by resellers via WhatsApp.

segments.src: 2. **Pemasaran langsung (*direct marketing*) — penjual menyebar pesan ke banyak orang lalu menunggu respons: katalog, telemarketing, dan TV home shopping** seperti Lejel Home Shopping atau MNC Shop.
segments.tr: 2. **Direct marketing** — the seller spreads messages to many people and then waits for responses: catalogs, telemarketing, and TV home shopping** such as Lejel Home Shopping or MNC Shop.

segments.src: 3. **E-commerce dan m-commerce** — toko online, marketplace seperti Tokopedia/Shopee/Blibli/Lazada, dan *social commerce* di Instagram maupun TikTok. Di Indonesia mayoritas transaksinya terjadi lewat ponsel, bukan komputer — inilah yang disebut **m-commerce**.
segments.tr: 3. **E-commerce and m-commerce** — online stores, marketplaces like Tokopedia/Shopee/Blibli/Lazada, and *social commerce* on Instagram and TikTok. In Indonesia most transactions occur via mobile phones, not computers — this is called **m-commerce**.

segments.src: 4. **Mesin penjual otomatis (*vending machine*)** — masih kecil porsinya di Indonesia, tapi mulai lumrah di stasiun MRT, bandara, dan lobi perkantoran.
segments.tr: 4. **Automatic vending machines** — still a small share in Indonesia, but becoming common at MRT stations, airports, and office lobbies.

segments.src: Yang penting dipahami: menghapus toko bukan sekadar "menghemat sewa".
segments.tr: What's important to understand: closing a store is not simply "saving on rent".

segments.src: Ia **memindahkan biaya**, bukan menghilangkannya.
segments.tr: It **shifts costs**, it doesn't eliminate them.

segments.src: | Yang hilang | Yang muncul menggantikan |
segments.tr: | What disappears | What takes its place |

segments.src: | Sewa gerai & renovasi | Biaya iklan dan promo untuk dapat trafik |
segments.tr: | Store rent & renovation | Advertising and promotional costs to attract traffic |

segments.src: | Pramuniaga | Admin chat, tim konten, host live |
segments.tr: | Store staff | Chat admin, content team, live host |

segments.src: | Rak fisik terbatas | Gudang, packing, ongkir, *last-mile* |
segments.tr: | Limited physical shelves | Warehouse, packing, shipping, *last-mile* |

segments.src: | Pembeli lihat & pegang barang | Foto, video, ulasan, retur |
segments.tr: | Customers see & hold products | Photos, videos, reviews, returns |

segments.src: Tiga konsekuensi yang selalu muncul di literatur ritel:
segments.tr: Three consequences that always appear in retail literature:

segments.src: **Pertama, rak jadi (hampir) tak terbatas.** Toko fisik harus memilih 3.000 item terlaris karena raknya habis.
segments.tr: **First, shelves become (almost) unlimited.** Physical stores must select 3,000 best-selling items because their shelves are full.

segments.src: Marketplace bisa memajang jutaan SKU, termasuk barang yang cuma laku sepuluh kali setahun.
segments.tr: Marketplaces can display millions of SKUs, including products that sell only ten times a year.

segments.src: Inilah **ekor panjang (*long tail*)**: banyak barang niche yang secara total bisa menyaingi barang laris.
segments.tr: This is the **long tail**: many niche products that collectively can rival bestselling items.

segments.src: **Kedua, masalah utamanya berubah dari lokasi jadi kepercayaan.** Di pasar, Anda pegang barangnya.
segments.tr: **Second, the main problem shifts from location to trust.** At a market, you hold the product.

segments.src: Online, Anda cuma lihat foto.
segments.tr: Online, you only see a photo.

segments.src: Maka ritel nirtoko tumbuh dengan alat-alat pembangun kepercayaan: **rekening bersama (*escrow*) yang menahan uang sampai barang diterima, ulasan dan rating, garansi retur, dan COD (*cash on delivery*)** yang di Indonesia jadi jembatan penting bagi pembeli yang belum nyaman bayar di muka.
segments.tr: Then non-store retail grows with trust-building tools: **escrow** that holds money until the product is received, reviews and ratings, return guarantees, and cash on delivery (*cash on delivery*)** which in Indonesia becomes an important bridge for buyers who are not yet comfortable paying upfront.

segments.src: **Ketiga, biaya jadi variabel.** Toko fisik bayar sewa entah ramai atau sepi.
segments.tr: **Third, costs become variable.** Physical stores pay rent whether busy or slow.

segments.src: Toko online bayar ongkir, komisi platform, dan iklan per transaksi.
segments.tr: Online stores pay shipping, platform commissions, and advertising per transaction.

segments.src: Artinya lebih mudah memulai, tapi juga lebih mudah "sibuk tapi tidak untung".
segments.tr: This means it's easier to start, but also easier to be "busy but unprofitable".

segments.src: Dan **live commerce** — host menjual sambil siaran langsung — sebetulnya bukan hal baru.
segments.tr: And **live commerce** — the host sells while streaming live — is actually not new.

segments.src: Itu TV home shopping yang pindah ke layar ponsel, ditambah kolom komentar dan tombol beli.
segments.tr: It's TV home shopping that moved to mobile screens, plus a comments section and a buy button.

segments.src: Bedanya: siapa pun bisa jadi penyiarnya.
segments.tr: The difference: anyone can be the broadcaster.

segments.src: ## Dalam Keseharian
segments.tr: ## In Daily Life

segments.src: Bu Rina di Bandung membuat keripik pisang.
segments.tr: Mrs. Rina in Bandung makes banana chips.

segments.src: Ia menimbang dua pilihan (angka di bawah hanya ilustrasi kasar, bukan data pasar):
segments.tr: She weighs two options (the numbers below are just rough illustrations, not market data):

segments.src: **Opsi A — kios kecil di area ramai.**
segments.tr: **Option A — small kiosk in a busy area.**

segments.src: Sewa Rp 4.000.000/bulan, satu penjaga Rp 2.500.000, listrik dan lain-lain Rp 500.000.
segments.tr: Rent Rp 4,000,000/month, one attendant Rp 2,500,000, electricity and other Rp 500,000.

segments.src: Total biaya tetap sekitar **Rp 7.000.000 per bulan** sebelum sebungkus keripik pun terjual.
segments.tr: Total fixed costs approximately **Rp 7,000,000 per month** before even one pack of chips is sold.

segments.src: Kalau margin kotor per bungkus Rp 8.000, ia harus jual sekitar 875 bungkus hanya untuk balik modal biaya tetap.
segments.tr: If the gross margin per pack is Rp 8,000, she needs to sell about 875 packs just to break even on fixed costs.

segments.src: Kelebihannya: orang lewat, mencium aromanya, langsung beli.
segments.tr: The advantage: people pass by, smell the aroma, and buy immediately.

segments.src: Trafiknya gratis karena sudah termasuk dalam sewa.
segments.tr: The traffic is free because it's already included in the rent.

segments.src: **Opsi B — jualan dari dapur rumah lewat marketplace dan Instagram.**
segments.tr: **Option B — selling from home kitchen via marketplace and Instagram.**

segments.src: Sewa Rp 0.
segments.tr: Rent Rp 0.

segments.src: Tapi muncul pos baru: komisi platform, ongkir (sering ditanggung sebagian lewat promo gratis ongkir), biaya iklan agar produknya muncul di pencarian, kardus dan bubble wrap, plus waktunya sendiri membalas chat sampai malam.
segments.tr: But new costs emerge: platform commissions, shipping (often partially covered by free shipping promos), advertising costs to make the product appear in search, boxes and bubble wrap, plus her own time replying to chats until late.

segments.src: Jika biaya-biaya ini memakan Rp 3.000 dari margin Rp 8.000, ia dapat Rp 5.000 per bungkus — tapi **tanpa beban Rp 7.000.000 di awal bulan**.
segments.tr: If these costs consume Rp 3,000 from the Rp 8,000 margin, she gets Rp 5,000 per pack — but **without the burden of Rp 7,000,000 at the start of the month**.

segments.src: Jual 100 bungkus, untung Rp 500.000.
segments.tr: Sell 100 packs, profit Rp 500,000.

segments.src: Jual 0 bungkus, rugi hampir nol.
segments.tr: Sell 0 packs, lose almost nothing.

segments.src: Perhatikan pergeserannya: Opsi A adalah taruhan besar di depan dengan risiko tetap; Opsi B adalah risiko kecil tapi Bu Rina kini harus jadi fotografer, admin, dan orang yang paham kenapa produknya tidak muncul di halaman pertama pencarian.
segments.tr: Notice the shift: Option A is a big bet upfront with fixed risk; Option B is small risk but now Mrs. Rina must be a photographer, admin, and someone who understands why her product doesn't appear on the first page of search results.

segments.src: Setelah enam bulan, Bu Rina menemukan pola yang khas ritel modern Indonesia: pesanan meledak saat ia **live** tiap Jumat malam sambil menggoreng, pembeli luar kota banyak yang minta **COD**, dan pelanggan Jakarta justru minta bisa ambil sendiri di titik tertentu.
segments.tr: After six months, Mrs. Rina discovers a pattern typical of modern Indonesian retail: orders skyrocket when she **goes live** every Friday night while frying, out-of-town buyers often request **cash on delivery**, and Jakarta customers actually ask to pick up at a certain point.

segments.src: Ia akhirnya membuka satu gerai kecil — bukan sebagai sumber utama penjualan, melainkan sebagai gudang, studio live, dan titik ambil.
segments.tr: She finally opens a small store — not as the main source of sales, but as a warehouse, live studio, and pickup point.

segments.src: Toko fisik dan nirtoko tidak saling membunuh; mereka bergabung.
segments.tr: Physical and non-store retail don't kill each other; they combine.

segments.src: Itulah yang disebut **omnichannel**, dan akan kita bahas lebih dalam di seri berikutnya.
segments.tr: That's called **omnichannel**, and we'll discuss it further in the next series.

segments.src: ## Rangkuman 3 Baris
segments.tr: ## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. Ritel nirtoko adalah penjualan eceran tanpa gerai fisik: penjualan langsung, pemasaran langsung (katalog/telemarketing/TV home shopping), e-commerce & m-commerce, serta vending machine.
segments.tr: 1. Non-store retail is retail sales without a physical store: direct selling, direct marketing (catalogs/telemarketing/TV home shopping), e-commerce & m-commerce, and vending machines.

segments.src: 2. Menghapus toko tidak menghapus biaya — sewa dan pramuniaga berganti menjadi iklan, ongkir, packing, dan pelayanan chat; biaya tetap berubah jadi biaya variabel.
segments.tr: 2. Closing a store doesn't eliminate costs — rent and staff are replaced by advertising, shipping, packing, and chat service; fixed costs change into variable costs.

segments.src: 3. Karena pembeli tidak bisa memegang barang, ritel nirtoko hidup dari mesin kepercayaan: escrow, ulasan, garansi retur, dan COD — dan live commerce pada dasarnya adalah TV home shopping yang pindah ke ponsel.
segments.tr: 3. Because customers can't touch products, non-store retail lives from trust mechanisms: escrow, reviews, return guarantees, and cash on delivery — and live commerce is essentially TV home shopping that moved to mobile phones.

segments.src: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri
segments.tr: ## ✅ Self-Check Quiz

segments.src: **1.** Manakah yang **bukan** termasuk ritel nirtoko?
segments.tr: **1.** Which of the following is **not** considered non-store retail?

segments.src: - (a) Lejel Home Shopping di televisi
segments.tr: - (a) Lejel Home Shopping on television

segments.src: - (b) Minimarket di ujung gang
segments.tr: - (b) A minimarket at the end of the street

segments.src: - (c) Reseller skincare yang jualan lewat WhatsApp
segments.tr: - (c) A skincare reseller selling via WhatsApp

segments.src: - (d) Mesin penjual minuman di stasiun MRT
segments.tr: - (d) A beverage vending machine at an MRT station

segments.src: **2.** (O/X) Karena tidak membayar sewa gerai, ritel nirtoko secara otomatis punya biaya lebih rendah daripada ritel bertoko.
segments.tr: **2.** (T/F) Because non-store retail doesn't pay store rent, it automatically has lower costs than physical store retail.

segments.src: **3.** Istilah "ekor panjang" (*long tail*) dalam konteks ritel online paling tepat menggambarkan:
segments.tr: **3.** The term "long tail" in the context of online retail most accurately describes:

segments.src: - (a) Antrean panjang pelanggan saat promo tanggal kembar
segments.tr: - (a) Long customer queues during twin-date promotions

segments.src: - (b) Waktu pengiriman yang lama ke luar Jawa
segments.tr: - (b) Long shipping times to areas outside Java

segments.src: - (c) Banyaknya produk niche berpenjualan kecil yang secara total menjadi besar
segments.tr: - (c) The multitude of niche products with small individual sales that collectively become significant

segments.src: - (d) Rantai pasok dari pabrik sampai konsumen
segments.tr: - (d) The supply chain from factory to consumer

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Today's Terms

segments.src: - **Ritel nirtoko (*non-store retailing*)** — penjualan eceran ke konsumen akhir tanpa gerai fisik.
segments.tr: - **Non-store retail** (*non-store retailing*) — retail sales to end consumers without a physical store.

segments.src: - **M-commerce** — transaksi jual-beli yang dilakukan lewat perangkat mobile; kanal dominan di Indonesia.
segments.tr: - **M-commerce** — buying and selling transactions conducted via mobile devices; the dominant channel in Indonesia.

segments.src: - **Live commerce** — penjualan lewat siaran langsung dengan host, gabungan hiburan TV home shopping dan tombol beli instan.
segments.tr: - **Live commerce** — selling through live streaming with a host, combining TV home shopping entertainment and an instant buy button.

segments.src: - **Rekening bersama (*escrow*)** — pihak ketiga menahan pembayaran sampai barang diterima pembeli, sebagai penjamin kepercayaan.
segments.tr: - **Escrow** — a third party holds payment until the buyer receives the product, serving as a trust guarantee.

segments.src: - **Ekor panjang (*long tail*)** — fenomena banyaknya produk yang laku sedikit-sedikit, namun jumlah totalnya menyaingi produk terlaris.
segments.tr: - **Long tail** — the phenomenon of many products selling in small quantities, but whose total sales rival bestselling products.

segments.src: - **Last-mile** — tahap akhir pengiriman dari gudang atau hub ke alamat pembeli; biasanya bagian termahal dari logistik.
segments.tr: - **Last-mile** — the final stage of delivery from warehouse or hub to buyer's address; usually the most expensive part of logistics.

segments.src: *Jawaban: **1 → (b)**.
Minimarket adalah gerai fisik; tiga pilihan lain menjual tanpa toko.
segments.tr: A minimarket is a physical store; the other three options sell without a store.

segments.src: **2 → X (salah)**.
segments.tr: **2 → F (false)**.

segments.src: Sewa memang hilang, tetapi digantikan biaya iklan, komisi platform, ongkir, packing, dan penanganan retur — yang berubah adalah struktur biayanya (dari tetap ke variabel), bukan otomatis besarannya.
segments.tr: Rent is eliminated, but replaced by advertising costs, platform commissions, shipping, packing, and return handling — what changes is the cost structure (from fixed to variable), not automatically the amount.

segments.src: Rak digital yang nyaris tak terbatas memungkinkan produk niche dipajang, dan akumulasi penjualan kecil-kecil itu bisa sangat besar.*
segments.tr: The nearly unlimited digital shelf allows niche products to be displayed, and the accumulation of small individual sales can be very large.*

id-20260924-news-3.title: 4,922 Schools Affected by Disaster in Sumatra Resume Learning, Government Prepares Five Programs and Rp5.6 Trillion for Education Recovery

segments.src: Ribuan sekolah di tiga provinsi di Pulau Sumatera yang sempat terganggu akibat bencana kini kembali menjalankan kegiatan belajar mengajar.
segments.tr: Thousands of schools in three provinces on the island of Sumatra, which were disrupted by disaster, have now resumed teaching and learning activities.

segments.src: Satuan Tugas Percepatan Rehabilitasi dan Rekonstruksi (Satgas PRR) Pascabencana Sumatera melaporkan bahwa per 22 September 2026, sebanyak **4.922 sekolah** di Aceh, Sumatera Utara, dan Sumatera Barat sudah kembali menggelar pembelajaran.
segments.tr: The Task Force for Acceleration of Rehabilitation and Reconstruction (Satgas PRR) for Post-Disaster Sumatra reports that as of September 22, 2026, **4,922 schools** in Aceh, North Sumatra, and West Sumatra have resumed holding classes.

segments.src: Kabar ini menjadi salah satu capaian penting dalam upaya pemulihan wilayah terdampak.
segments.tr: This is one of the important achievements in the effort to recover the affected areas.

segments.src: Di sisi lain, pemerintah menegaskan bahwa pekerjaan belum selesai, sebab sebagian sekolah masih belajar di fasilitas sementara dan sejumlah lainnya perlu dipindahkan ke lokasi yang lebih aman.
segments.tr: On the other hand, the government emphasizes that work is not yet complete, because some schools are still learning in temporary facilities and several others need to be relocated to safer locations.

segments.src: ## Proses Belajar Kembali Berjalan
segments.tr: ## Learning Process Resumed

segments.src: Informasi tersebut disampaikan Menteri Dalam Negeri Muhammad Tito Karnavian selaku Ketua Satgas PRR dalam rapat koordinasi di Posko Satgas PRR, Jakarta, pada Rabu, 23 September 2026.
segments.tr: This information was provided by Minister of Interior Muhammad Tito Karnavian, as Chairman of Satgas PRR, in a coordination meeting at the Satgas PRR Command Post in Jakarta on Wednesday, September 23, 2026.

segments.src: Menurutnya, proses belajar mengajar di 4.922 sekolah yang menjadi sasaran pemulihan kini sudah berjalan sepenuhnya.
segments.tr: According to him, the teaching and learning process in 4,922 schools targeted for recovery is now running fully.

segments.src: Berdasarkan data per 22 September 2026:
segments.tr: Based on data as of September 22, 2026:

segments.src: - **4.821 sekolah** telah kembali belajar di gedung asal.
segments.tr: - **4,821 schools** have resumed learning in their original buildings.

segments.src: - Sekolah lainnya masih memanfaatkan ruang kelas darurat atau fasilitas sementara sambil menunggu pembangunan permanen selesai.
segments.tr: - Other schools are still using emergency classrooms or temporary facilities while waiting for permanent construction to be completed.

segments.src: - Menteri Pendidikan Dasar dan Menengah (Mendikdasmen) Abdul Mu'ti menyebut masih ada dua sekolah yang menggunakan tenda belajar.
segments.tr: - The Minister of Elementary and Secondary Education (Mendikdasmen) Abdul Mu'ti mentioned that there are still two schools using learning tents.

segments.src: Tito menekankan bahwa jumlah sekolah yang harus dipulihkan sangat besar sehingga tidak mungkin diselesaikan dalam waktu singkat.
segments.tr: Tito emphasized that the number of schools that need to be recovered is very large so it cannot be completed in a short time.

segments.src: Meski begitu, ia menilai kondisi saat ini lebih baik dibandingkan masa awal pascabencana, ketika banyak sekolah belum bisa beroperasi secara normal.
segments.tr: Nevertheless, he assessed that the current condition is better compared to the early post-disaster period, when many schools could not yet operate normally.

segments.src: ## Lima Program Pemulihan Pendidikan
segments.tr: ## Five Education Recovery Programs

segments.src: Untuk mempercepat pemulihan, Kementerian Pendidikan Dasar dan Menengah (Kemendikdasmen) menyiapkan lima program utama dengan total anggaran sekitar **Rp5,6 triliun**.
segments.tr: To accelerate recovery, the Ministry of Elementary and Secondary Education (Kemendikdasmen) has prepared five main programs with a total budget of approximately **Rp5.6 trillion**.

segments.src: Kelima program tersebut adalah:
segments.tr: The five programs are:

segments.src: 1. **Revitalisasi satuan pendidikan**, yakni perbaikan dan penataan kembali bangunan sekolah yang rusak.
segments.tr: 1. **Revitalization of educational units**, namely repair and reorganization of damaged school buildings.

segments.src: 2. **Penyediaan sarana dan peralatan sekolah**, seperti perlengkapan belajar dan fasilitas penunjang.
segments.tr: 2. **Provision of school facilities and equipment**, such as learning materials and supporting facilities.

segments.src: 3. **Ruang kelas darurat**, agar siswa tetap bisa belajar selama bangunan permanen dikerjakan.
segments.tr: 3. **Emergency classrooms**, so students can continue learning while permanent buildings are under construction.

segments.src: 4. **Dukungan psikososial dan kesiapsiagaan bencana**, untuk membantu pemulihan kondisi psikologis warga sekolah dan memperkuat kesiapan menghadapi risiko di masa depan.
segments.tr: 4. **Psychosocial support and disaster preparedness**, to help restore the psychological well-being of school communities and strengthen preparedness to face risks in the future.

segments.src: 5. **Bantuan bagi peserta didik dan tenaga kependidikan terdampak**.
segments.tr: 5. **Assistance for affected students and educational personnel**.

segments.src: Dari total anggaran tersebut, **Rp3,03 triliun** dialokasikan untuk revitalisasi sarana pendidikan.
segments.tr: Of the total budget, **Rp3.03 trillion** is allocated for revitalizing educational facilities.

segments.src: Artinya, lebih dari separuh dana diprioritaskan untuk memulihkan bangunan dan fasilitas fisik sekolah, sedangkan sisanya dibagi untuk empat program lainnya.
segments.tr: This means more than half of the funds are prioritized for restoring school buildings and physical facilities, while the remainder is divided among the four other programs.

segments.src: ## Tantangan yang Masih Dihadapi
segments.tr: ## Remaining Challenges

segments.src: Meski pembelajaran sudah berjalan, sejumlah tantangan masih perlu diselesaikan.
segments.tr: Although learning has resumed, several challenges still need to be addressed.

segments.src: **Relokasi 97 sekolah.** Terdapat 97 sekolah yang dinilai perlu direlokasi karena lokasinya tidak layak atau berada di kawasan rawan bencana.
segments.tr: **Relocation of 97 schools.** There are 97 schools deemed in need of relocation because their locations are unsuitable or in disaster-prone areas.

segments.src: Pemerintah pusat meminta pemerintah daerah segera menyediakan lahan pengganti agar proses pembangunan dapat dimulai.
segments.tr: The central government is asking local governments to promptly provide replacement land so the construction process can begin.

segments.src: **Progres fisik di bawah 50 persen.** Sekolah dengan capaian pembangunan fisik di bawah 50 persen akan mendapat pendampingan lebih intensif agar penyelesaiannya tidak tertinggal.
segments.tr: **Physical progress below 50 percent.** Schools with physical construction progress below 50 percent will receive more intensive support to ensure they are not left behind in completion.

segments.src: **Kondisi lapangan.** Kecepatan pemulihan dipengaruhi berbagai faktor, mulai dari perbedaan kondisi geografis, kerusakan akses jalan dan jembatan, ketersediaan material bangunan, hingga potensi bencana susulan.
segments.tr: **Field conditions.** The speed of recovery is influenced by various factors, ranging from differences in geographic conditions, damage to road and bridge access, availability of construction materials, to the potential for secondary disasters.

segments.src: Satgas PRR juga memetakan ruas jalan dan jembatan yang perlu diperbaiki agar pengiriman material dan mobilisasi pekerja berjalan lancar.
segments.tr: Satgas PRR also maps road and bridge sections that need to be repaired so material delivery and worker mobilization can run smoothly.

segments.src: ## Mengapa Pemulihan Sekolah Penting
segments.tr: ## Why School Recovery Is Important

segments.src: Sekolah bukan hanya tempat belajar.
segments.tr: School is not just a place to learn.

segments.src: Bagi anak-anak dan keluarga yang terdampak bencana, sekolah juga menjadi ruang yang membantu mengembalikan rutinitas dan rasa aman.
segments.tr: For children and families affected by the disaster, school also becomes a space that helps restore routine and a sense of safety.

segments.src: Karena itu, kelanjutan pembelajaran, dukungan psikososial, serta kepastian bagi guru dan tenaga kependidikan menjadi bagian yang tidak terpisahkan dari upaya rehabilitasi.
segments.tr: Therefore, continuation of learning, psychosocial support, and assurance for teachers and educational personnel become an inseparable part of rehabilitation efforts.

segments.src: Ke depan, tantangan utamanya adalah memastikan seluruh sekolah dapat kembali menempati bangunan permanen yang aman, serta menjaga agar anggaran yang telah dialokasikan terserap tepat sasaran, tepat waktu, dan bisa dipantau oleh masyarakat.
segments.tr: Going forward, the main challenge is to ensure that all schools can return to safe permanent buildings, and to ensure that the allocated budget is used correctly, on time, and can be monitored by the public.

segments.src: ## Yang Perlu Diperhatikan Orang Tua dan Masyarakat
segments.tr: ## What Parents and Communities Need to Pay Attention To

segments.src: - Pantau informasi resmi dari sekolah dan dinas pendidikan setempat mengenai jadwal serta lokasi belajar.
segments.tr: - Monitor official information from schools and local education offices regarding learning schedules and locations.

segments.src: - Manfaatkan layanan dukungan psikososial yang disediakan sekolah atau pemerintah daerah bila anak membutuhkan pendampingan.
segments.tr: - Take advantage of psychosocial support services provided by schools or local governments if your child needs support.

segments.src: - Sampaikan masukan atau laporan mengenai kondisi sekolah melalui kanal resmi pemerintah daerah atau dinas pendidikan.
segments.tr: - Provide feedback or reports about school conditions through official channels of local governments or education offices.

segments.src: *Catatan: Artikel ini disusun berdasarkan keterangan resmi Satgas PRR dan Kemendikdasmen yang dilaporkan sejumlah media nasional per 23 September 2026.
segments.tr: *Note: This article was compiled based on official information from Satgas PRR and Kemendikdasmen as reported by several national media outlets as of September 23, 2026.

segments.src: Data dapat berubah seiring perkembangan di lapangan; rujuk selalu pengumuman resmi pemerintah untuk informasi terbaru.*
segments.tr: Data may change as developments unfold; always refer to official government announcements for the latest information.*
